Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

 $100M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
We 
lean in: 
ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We 
fight for excellence:

We
 grow together:
 as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
About the Role
The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora.
This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate.
Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide,and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other
member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time.
At the heart of the role is designing the client's adoption playbook and delivering a multi-year change-management programme that transforms how they work. You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption,define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.
You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.
What You'll Do
You'll own the global relationship end to end, leading the post-sale experience across every member firm we work with. Specifically, you will:
● Set the global adoption strategy for the account and lead its execution across regions. Engagement Managers in other markets will deliver their local programmes against the strategy and decisions you set, and you will be accountable for coherence and outcomes globally.
● Act as the primary point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice, while travelling frequently to other member firms to build senior relationships and support local delivery in person.
● Design the client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how the firm adopts Legora and transforms the way it works.

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.location: London or remote within the UK
jobs.description_text:
About Griffin
Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.
We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.
We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.
Learn more about what we do
Our culture
We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.
We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work 
and
 home life.
We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.
Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.
Learn more about our culture.
The team
The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers. You'll join one team that owns a product area end-to-end.
When we start work, we explore multiple solutions before picking one. You'll write RFCs, build proof-of-concepts, and run experiments to validate approaches. Once we commit to building something, we care about maintainability more than cleverness, observability more than hoping it works, and scalability more than premature optimisation. We ship quality code over hitting arbitrary deadlines. Once something goes live, we refactor the rough edges rather than polish what's already working
The opportunity
Right now, we're building card issuing from scratch, going direct on Faster Payments, enabling cross-border payments, and building term deposit accounts. Day to day, this means: writing the reconciliation systems that process millions of FPS transactions, implementing double-entry accounting that tracks card spending and settlements, designing webhook infrastructure with message signing and replay protection, building API versioning that lets us evolve without breaking customers, or creating payment approval workflows that satisfy both user experience and compliance requirements.
What success looks like
Success here is about impact beyond your own code: improving how we work, making other engineers more productive, and building systems that our customers (other developers) actually want to use. This looks like:
redesigning the transaction reconciliation service to handle 10x throughput before we hit FPS volume limits
fixing the root cause of webhook delivery failures so we stop getting paged at 3am
building a Bazel rule that cuts build times in half for the whole team
writing an RFC that becomes the pattern we use for all event-driven services
pairing with another engineer to help them reason through FoundationDB transaction semantics
owning card issuing from initial RFC through to processing the first live transaction - making every architecture and implementation decision along the way.
What you'll own

Contribute to the adoption effort practice group by practice group. Discovery sessions, use case validation, drop-ins, enablement. The shape varies by firm and by wave.

Closely collaborate with Customer Enablement, Product and Marketing. Translate client feedback into actionable insights and product direction to benefit all functions across the organisation. Being a team player is key.
Represent Legora in the market. Speaking at events, hosting client sessions, contributing to how our story gets told publicly. Our strongest engagement people are visible in the legal community, not only inside their own accounts.

Our vision is that our Finance team plays a central part of the business, somewhere the Board can rely on to support strategic planning. The team are thought leaders in relation to finance, regulatory, planning and strategic matters.

This role is Griffin's essential support to the Treasurer — giving you hands-on ownership of the reporting, cash management, and dealing that keep our treasury function running smoothly. jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead - EMEA
jobs.description_text:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.
 
We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 
As a product marketer at Vanta, you’ll help bring this vision to life by defining the new category of trust management, shaping Vanta’s positioning and differentiators externally, and influencing our product and business roadmap. We sit at the intersection of Marketing & Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and Customer Success and revel in connecting all of these teams to drive the business forward. Research, analysis, curiosity, storytelling, and project management are just a few of the attributes of our team – in addition to being open, empathetic, and genuinely nice people.
As the EMEA Product Marketing lead, you will be responsible for bringing Vanta’s story to the EMEA audience to help us drive sustainable growth in the market. You’ll craft compelling messaging that’s tailored to the region, based on insights from buyer and market research. You’ll lead product launches to help amplify Vanta’s presence in the region, and partner closely with our product management team to identify growth opportunities for us to continue building our product. Finally, you’ll partner closely with our GTM organisation to expand Vanta’s footprint and accelerate our growth.
What you’ll do as a Product Marketing Lead at Vanta:
Define and manage go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Vanta’s business in EMEA tailored to the unique opportunities across the EMEA region
Develop tailored messaging and positioning for EMEA based on market research and customer insights
Partner with our EMEA growth team on the development and execution of targeted marketing campaigns, including tailored messaging and content that effectively engage local audiences and drive business objectives
Plan and execute large product launches (including GTM enablement of sales and customer success), report back on performance, and optimize our launch processes for scale
Author compelling content for each stage of the customer journey, from blog posts to sales collateral
Talk regularly to Vanta’s customers, analyze your own data, and understand our competitive landscape to help shape the product strategy and roadmap and inform Vanta’s overall EMEA marketing strategy
Partner closely with the EMEA team at Vanta – including demand gen, sales, customer success, and product—to help achieve our objectives in the market
Refine Vanta’s pricing and packaging based on deep insights around the market, our product value, and customer needs in partnership with finance, operations, product, sales, and customer success
Be a strong customer champion, creative marketer, and problem solver
How to be successful in this role:
Have 7+ years of Product Marketing experience, with an emphasis on B2B SaaS
Have a deep empathy for users and an ability to adapt communication to best reach, engage and differentiate Vanta to your audience
Enjoy working with data and pairing those quantitative conclusions with the qualitative conversations you have with users
Find delight in understanding how things work and then explaining your newfound knowledge to others
Must be based on London or Dublin, this role will be hybrid in-office
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
What you can expect as a Vanta’n:
Industry-competitive salary and equity
100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage
16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend
Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend
Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office
Pension matching
